decisions.reason: The multi-model height-adjustable desk line is a substantial investment that fits the firm's announced focus on flexible workplaces, and post-pandemic demand for adaptable office furniture gives management reason to persist even though it has not been observed on the website since 2019.

The floor cushions complement the flagship rug collection and use its carpet material, so management will likely keep them and attribute weak sales to market build-up and pandemic disruption, although they are a more peripheral item and carry a higher risk of being dropped.
The high standing table serves the workplace and conference direction at low ongoing cost, so the firm is likely to keep it despite uncertain results while office demand recovers.

As the publicly presented flagship of the firm's new direction, the rug collection carries heavy visible commitment and a need to justify earlier decisions, so persistence is very likely even if results disappoint.
